metadata.scenario: A returning client follows up on a complaint they made, wanting to ensure it is being addressed. Category: Follow-up.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Jennifer Taylor. I’m calling to follow up on a complaint I made last week regarding my grandmother's companion care. Hi Jennifer, thanks for reaching out. I remember your case. Could you remind me what the specific concern was? Yes, we had an issue with the caregiver not showing up on time a few days in a row, and it left my grandmother without help for hours. I’m really sorry to hear that, Jennifer. That’s definitely not the level of service we strive for. Thank you, I appreciate that. Have you been able to address it with the caregiver? Yes, I spoke with the caregiver and reviewed our scheduling procedures. We’re implementing stricter follow-up protocols to prevent this from happening again. That sounds good. I hope it makes a difference. I believe it will. I also wanted to ask if your grandmother still needs the current level of service or if anything has changed? She still needs companion care and help with daily activities, but I think we might also need some assistance with meal preparation. We can certainly add meal preparation to her care plan. That’s something we can include in the companion care service. Great! What would that additional cost look like? For companion care, it would be $25 to $30 per hour, and meal preparation can be included within that time frame. Okay, that makes sense. Would you like me to update the care plan to reflect this change? Yes, please. That would be very helpful. I’ll take care of that right after this call. Is there anything else you'd like us to address? No, I think that covers everything. I just want to make sure my grandmother is taken care of, and I appreciate your follow-up. Absolutely, Jennifer. We value your trust and will ensure her care is a top priority. Thank you, Margaret. I feel better knowing you're handling this. It’s my pleasure. I’ll send you an updated care plan by email once it’s finalized. Sounds good! I’ll keep an eye out for it. Thank you for your understanding, Jennifer. If you have any more questions, feel free to reach out. I will. Thanks again! You're welcome! Have a great day! You too! Goodbye! Goodbye!
